player_prompt.intro:
O u player {player_id} mo gameng ya Indian Poker.
- 52-card deck; o bona ka karata ya mmusi.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) ka kgwedi, {max_rounds} kgwedi(s) e e seng kgwele.
- Ditshwanelo tse di makgethwa: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X ke polelo e e siameng ya <= ho kae chip count.)
- Karata e kgolo e e siiwa e fenya pot mo showdown.

invalid_move.ambiguous: Naya ka mabapi a lekgetho la setshaba, e.g. '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', kapa '[fold]'.
invalid_move.cannot_check: O ka se kgone [check] - o lebeletšane le go petšha.
invalid_move.amount_min: Palo ya go beela / go ntšha e swanetše go ba ≥ 1.
invalid_move.cannot_bet: Ga go na le tokelo ya [bet] - go swanetse [call] / [raise] / [fold].
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Ga go na selo seo o ka se bitšago; mohlomongwe [check].
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Diriša [bet X] go bula; ga go na tefo yeo e swanetšego go godišwa.
invalid_move.insufficient: Go se be le ditšhipi tše di lekanego bakeng sa tiro yeo.

board.possible_actions: Mediro ya gago e ka bago gona: {legal}

message.showdown_tie: Showdown tie: both {card}. Pot split – each receives {split}.

outcome.draw: Di-chip tše di lekanago ka morago ga makga a mantši
